newsitem.title: BRAZIL: RESEARCH ALERT-CVRD STARTED AS A BUY.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-CVRD STARTED AS A BUY.

text.p: ING Barings said it has started coverage of Brazilian mining firm Cia Vale do Rio Doce (CVRD) with a buy recommendation on the basis of the upside potential of its stock.
-- ING Barings said in a report that CVRD was expected to benefit from its privatization last May and show strong earnings growth into 1998.

-- The Dutch-owned bank said its 1997 and 1998 earnings estimates for CVRD are "above consensus and our analysts expect the company soon to announce management restructuring and a cost-reduction program."
-- It added those factors are likely to generate upward momentum in CVRD's stock price.
-- Moreover, the firm is expected to list its shares in the United States. Currently, its ADRs are traded over-the-counter in the U.S.
-- ING Barings also said it set a June 1998 target price for CVRD of $34 per local share, representing an upside potential of 27 percent.
-- CVRD is the world's largest iron ore producer.
-- Its blue-chip preferred share ended Monday at 27.70 reais while its common closed at 25.76 reais.
